newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends thinly traded session firmer.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends thinly traded session firmer.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures ended slightly higher in thin, featureless dealings Monday, bolstered light trade buying, floor sources said.
"The market is stuck in neutral gear," a dealer said. "The trade just continues to nibble."
Scale-up producer selling trimmed gains and help to keep prices rangebound, traders said.
October sugar settled up 0.03 cent at 12.03 cents a lb after trading from 12.12 to 11.99. March closed 0.04 firmer at 11.73, with back months 0.01 to 0.05 higher.
Trader said funds continued to roll out of October contract ahead of its expiry Sept 30. Total open interest in October futures remained high at 70,210 lots as of Friday.

A trader expects October's open interest to drop with October's options expiry this Friday. He said with over 20,000 lots of October calls in the money up to 12.00 cents, a good deal of those would be offset against futures.
